items.mainDefect: open(url) follows cross-host redirects after the host was checked only on the original URL, which allows SSRF and leaks the fetched data into a published post.

secondary.defect: The fetch has no timeouts, so a slow endpoint can hold a job worker indefinitely.

items.mainDefect: The Disqus import now calls TopicEmbed.import_remote, which ignores created_at, so each topic gets the import time instead of the original Disqus thread date.

secondary.defect: Removing the -c/--category option means every imported topic ends up uncategorized.
import_remote fetches each thread's URL synchronously with no error handling, so one dead link stops the whole import run.
